stop_definition: Ground-truth planar speed below 0.05 m/s for at least 0.4 simulated seconds after movement began; successful terminal parking excluded. Each route has a wall-clock timeout.

excluded_runs.candidate-c: First route shared GPU with another simulator; not a single-instance comparison.
excluded_runs.candidate-d: Duplicate benchmark publishers preempted each other; run discarded.

candidate-c.load_note: First routes overlapped with another user simulation; not comparable to single-instance baseline.

tests.known_preexisting_failure: reality overlap recovery speed: planner 0.15 versus controller 0.20, also present at HEAD; no reality settings modified.
